## FlagName type

Extracts the short names guaranteed to be flags in a hook tuple.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type FlagName<Hooks extends readonly Hook[]> = true extends IsUnion<Hooks> ? never : Hooks extends readonly [
    infer Head extends Hook,
    ...infer Tail extends Hook[]
] ? true extends IsUnion<Head> ? FlagName<Tail> : [Head] extends [Flag] ? Head extends `flag:${infer Name}` ? Name | FlagName<Tail> : never : FlagName<Tail> : never;
```
